description: Weekly domain-grouped updates, two ordinary PRs per repository, separate majors, and review before every merge.
prHeader: Review required: check dependency impact and CI before merging. Routine domain groups and separate major upgrades share two PR slots per repository; queued updates wait for a slot and the next Monday run.

packageRules.description: Group routine minor, patch, digest, and pin updates; later rules split operational domains.
Refresh npm ranges even when the newest eligible version already satisfies the old range.
Group routine development dependencies separately from application runtime dependencies.
Group routine container tag, digest, and initial pin updates across Dockerfiles, Compose, and other image consumers.
Group routine infrastructure updates across Kubernetes, Flux, Helm, Kustomize, and Terraform.
Group routine CI and development-environment updates, including action digests and the Renovate runner version.
Keep major upgrades separate from routine groups and preserve Renovate's related-package groups; never automerge.
Preserve first-party codeOps workflow and action branch refs without digest pinning; retain other update handling

Owner rule (1 of 2): report Python patch updates apart from minor ones so rule 2 can hold minors without hiding patches. No matchUpdateTypes here because Renovate reads separateMinorPatch before an update type exists.

Owner rule (2 of 2): never propose Python minor or major bumps such as 3.14 to 3.15; patch (3.14.7 to 3.14.8), digest and pin updates still flow. Matches by package name in every manager: python and other registry python images, setup-python python-version inputs, .python-version, requires-python, runtime.txt, and mise, asdf, proto, devbox, pixi, poetry and devcontainer pins. The setup-python action and the devcontainer python feature are not Python releases and are not matched. To move Python on purpose, edit the pin by hand or add a narrow enabled: true packageRule in the consumer repository.
